data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word अलक (alak) meaning 'immeasurable', 'unending', or 'immortal'. In Hindu mythology, Alak refers to the immortal part of the soul or the eternal essence of the universe. The name Alak carries the meaning “Immortal” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Alak usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
